hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it intercepts all swaps, computes quotes using a configurable price curve (CurveLib), and routes funds through Euler vaults — returning a custom BeforeSwapDelta to replace standard CLAMM execution. Liquidity addition and direct donations are intentionally blocked.
